posts.title: Using Cognitect's aws-api with AWS Transcribe
posts.description: Using Cognitect’s aws-api library to work with AWS is nice and easy (and simple). This post shows how to use it with AWS Transcribe for speech-to-text. aws-api is an idiomatic, data-oriented Clojure library for invoking AWS APIs.
